pageTitle: Ed bann tipti zanfan regil zot lemosion – Nivo 1 · Inspired
pageDescription: Enn formasion pratik 75 minit pou personel ELS lor ko-regilasion adapte avek laz, avek bann plan klas explike, bann zouti viziel orizinal, bann resours ofisiel spesialis ek enn sertifika fin formasion.
headerTitle: ELS · ANSEGNAN, ASISTAN PEDAGOZIK EK ADILT KI AKONPAGN ZANFAN
safeguarding: Early Learning Schools · Kree enn lien avan ou koriz
heroLead: Kone ki pou fer avan, pandan ek apre enn moman difisil. Prepar enn soutien adapte avek laz, enn kominikasion itil ek bann routinn toulezour ki zanfan kapav swiv avek led.
pilotNotice: Pou bann ansegnan adilt, asistan pedagozik ek adilt ki pran swin zanfan dan ELS. Bann ka prinsipal dan klas konsern bann zanfan 2–6 an; enn parti siplemanter pou bann bebe, ki idantifie kler, la pou personel ki otorize pou pran swin bebe dan zot travay. Servi bann lexanp imaziner ek bann prosedir aktiel ou lekol.
showAct: Obzerve. Kree enn lien. Soutenir. Ansegne.
showActText: Travay lor sis ka, konpar bann repons adilt adapte avek laz, pratik bann fraz itil ek terminn enn evaliasion 20 kestion. Tou bann repons esansiel pou sekirite bizin korek.
completionEvidenceText: Reget sa sis modil ek refleksion ki finn elarzi la, gagn omwin 80% avek tou bann repons esansiel pou sekirite korek, ek rekonet ou bann responsabilite. Sertifika lor ou nom ateste enn formasion an-lign; li pa ateste enn konpetans ki finn obzerve dan klas.
timing: Modil ek aktivite: anviron 60 minit · Evaliasion: 12 minit · Konfirmasion: 3 minit. Bann video opsionel ek lexplorasion bann zouti azout letan. Konfirm dire reel pandan enn test pilot avek personel.
applyUnderstanding: 2. Met seki ou finn konpran an pratik

response3: Dekrir ou bann premie mo, bann sanzman dan lanvironnman ek soutien pou sa zanfan imaziner-la.
response5: Servi zis sitiasion imaziner-la pou explik seki ou pou met an ekri ek ou bann desizion pou signale.

emailIntro: Silvouple trouv mo bann rezilta an-lign pou Ed bann tipti zanfan regil zot lemosion – Nivo 1 anba. Mo bann refleksion finn termine me pa finn gagn not. Sertifika-la konsern zis laprantisaz an-lign. Mo pou aplik seki mo finn aprann dan kad bann prosedir aktiel lekol ek bann plan soutien individiel.
emailReady: Imel ki finn prepare pare. Li PA finn anvwaye. Ouver li dan ou aplikasion imel, verifye destinater-la ek anvway li. Si ou aplikasion pa kapav modifie bann fisie .eml, atas bann rezilta konplet ek sertifika-la dan enn nouvo imel. Klik lor lien-la si telesarzman pa finn koumanse:
contactCards: Soutien toulezour, bann repons adilt ki finn dakor, bann routinn klas, personel ki pran rele ek travay ansam avek bann fami.
Bann plan soutien individiel, bann adaptasion kominikasion ek lanvironnman sansoriel, ek bann prosedir apropriye pou oriant ver bann servis.
Enn revelasion, enn inkietid lor ditor, neglizans ouswa konportman enn adilt. Servi lot prosedir indepandan kan neseser.
Kisannla pou kontakte kan responsab abitie-la pa disponib, li konserne par inkietid-la ouswa li pa finn azir lor enn inkietid.
Led kan enn adilt bizin enn rele, gidans ouswa soutien; bann inkietid lor konportman personel swiv prosedir lekol pou signale.
Bann dispozision pou ka irzan / premie sekour
Kouma demann led bann dimounn forme vit, protez group-la ek gagn asistans medikal irzan.
translationReviewNotice: Sa tradiksion-la enn brouyon ki pa finn aprouve. Li bizin enn revizion par enn dimounn ki metrize Kreol Morisien ek ki ena lexpertiz dan ledikasion tipti zanfan ek proteksion zanfan. Si enn fraz pa kler, verifye version angle ek demann responsab ou lekol konsey avan ou aplik li.
translationReviewShort: Tradiksion brouyon ki pa finn aprouve, ankor pou revize par enn spesialis ki metrize Kreol Morisien.

Bann not fer ladiferans ant bann konsey pratik, bann materyel bann program avek enn mark ek bann prev resers.
